timing_limitations: Single uninstrumented control run per configuration; shadow phase timers uncalibrated. Sums of per-phase rank maxima are sampled diagnostic aggregates, not full-step costs or recoverable production time. The 256-rank prototype has oracles enabled; 83/160 prototypes do not.
decision: Keep Stage266 accepted and Stage273 separate. Next complete one bounded fused producer/restriction/consumer slice, cache geometry and addresses, preserve final shared writes, bound halo/physics publication, and retire displaced production work. Gate correctness and uninstrumented performance before further removals; no shared-memory change stacked into this migration.
